methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing collected from each vendor's official pricing page or authoritative third-party listing, accessed 2026-06-15. Telephony fields (minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall) are null on all plans — non-telephony vertical. monthlyUsd reflects effective monthly cost at the smallest self-serve tier: annualized where only annual billing is published, month-to-month where available. Friendly Captcha publishes prices only in EUR on their website (friendlycaptcha.com); no vendor-confirmed USD price exists, so all its paid tiers carry monthlyUsd=null with a note (a GetApp listing's '$9'/'$39' are par symbol-swaps of the EUR figures, not real conversions, and are not treated as confirmed). GeeTest and Arkose Labs have no published self-serve pricing — all tiers are contact-sales/custom; monthlyUsd=null throughout. Cloudflare Turnstile Free tier is genuinely $0 with no rate limits on verifications; Enterprise requires contacting sales. reCAPTCHA Enterprise Premium tier: 0–10,000 assessments/month free, 10,001–100,000 assessments = $8 flat fee, above 100,000 = $0.001/assessment ($1 per 1,000); effective monthlyUsd=$8 reflects the smallest paid commitment. annualDiscountPct=null for reCAPTCHA as pricing is pay-as-you-go with no published annual discount.

vendors.provenance: https://www.hcaptcha.com/pricing accessed 2026-06-15. Basic (free) tier is permanently free with unlimited evaluations. Pro at $139/mo month-to-month or $99/mo when billed annually (~29% discount); includes 100K evaluations/month with $0.99 per 1,000 overage. Enterprise is custom/contact-sales.

plans.name: Pro

vendors.name: reCAPTCHA Enterprise
vendors.provenance: https://docs.cloud.google.com/recaptcha/docs/billing-information accessed 2026-06-15. Essentials: free up to 10,000 assessments/month (no billing account required). Premium: first 10,000 assessments free; 10,001–100,000 = $8 flat fee; above 100,000 = $0.001/assessment ($1 per 1,000). Enterprise: volume discounts via sales contact.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Free up to 10,000 assessments/month. Applied automatically to projects without a billing account. Requests return an error if limit exceeded.

plans.name: Premium

plans.name: Enterprise

vendors.name: Arkose Labs
vendors.provenance: https://www.arkoselabs.com/ accessed 2026-06-15. No self-serve pricing published. Site presents only 'Schedule a Demo' and 'Schedule a Meeting' CTAs. All tiers are enterprise/contact-sales only.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: No published self-serve pricing. Bot management + CAPTCHA enforcement platform targeting large enterprises. Pricing via sales demo only.

vendors.name: Friendly Captcha
vendors.provenance: Official site friendlycaptcha.com (verified 2026-06-15) publishes pricing in EUR only — Starter €9/mo, Growth €39/mo, Advanced €200/mo; no USD pricing published by the vendor. A GetApp listing shows '$9'/'$39', but those are par currency-symbol swaps of the EUR figures, not a vendor-confirmed USD price (€9 ≈ $10 at prevailing rates, not $9), so they are not treated as confirmed. Per methodology, all EUR-native paid tiers have monthlyUsd=null with a note rather than an unconfirmed USD figure. Free tier ($0) is unambiguous. Privacy-by-design: no image tasks, GDPR/CCPA compliant, EU data residency. 30-day free trial on all paid plans.
